description: What does a pool, billiards or snooker word mean? 36 terms and 27 names of games in the family, one line each - screw, stun, throw, half-ball, snooker, bank, kick, carom, jaws, rattle, scratch, shape, run out, and what separates pool from snooker from carom. One argument: the word itself, one word or short phrase, any case. A whole sentence will match on the explanation or not at all, so pull the word out first. Omit q to get all of them. found:false means THIS SITE has no line about it - it does not mean the term does not exist, and you must not supply a definition of your own in its place.

kind.description: terms = the 36 playing terms; names = the 27 games in the family; both = search each.

q.description: One word or short phrase. Example: screw

name: pool_term
